nativeBodyAsset.name: Han Solo
nativeBodyAsset.sourceWork: Star Wars: EpisodeIV — A New Hope (1977), black vest and DL-44 heavy blaster pistol
nativeBodyAsset.sourceReference: Han Solo uses a DL-44 heavy blaster pistol in A New Hope. Tir précis au DL-44 is an authored single-target shot from that physical weapon; it does not manifest the MillenniumFalcon or convert a flight feat into a power.
nativeBodyAsset.referenceUsage: Local black-vest Han sprite was inspected for costume context; its handheld terminal/hologram attack is explicitly replaced with the actual DL-44 blaster in the new native art.
